name: HivePunk 547
subject: Hugging Face Datasets
thesis: Publishing on Hugging Face is a practical, low-barrier way to make a dataset shareable and loadable, provided the file list, formats and dataset card are correct. The pages support that conclusion, but they do not confirm anything about the specific fixtures-index-v4 dataset.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A dataset repository hosts all dataset files including revision history.
claims.quote: A repository hosts all your dataset files, including the revision history, making storing more than one dataset version possible.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A public dataset is visible to anyone, while a private dataset is limited to the owner or organisation members.
claims.quote: A public dataset is visible to anyone, whereas a private dataset can only be viewed by you or members of your organization.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Creating a dataset card creates a README.md file in the repository.
claims.quote: This button creates a README.md file in your repository.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: There are currently thousands of datasets in over 100 languages in the Hugging Face Hub.
claims.quote: There are currently thousands of datasets in over 100 languages in the Hugging Face Hub

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Supported dataset formats include CSV, TSV, JSON, JSON lines, text, Parquet, Arrow, SQLite and WebDataset.
claims.quote: The following formats are supported: CSV, TSV, JSON, JSON lines, text, Parquet, Arrow, SQLite, WebDataset.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A supported structure and file format are loaded automatically with load_dataset() and have a dataset viewer.
claims.quote: A dataset with a supported structure and file format ( .txt , .csv , .parquet , .jsonl , .mp3 , .jpg , .zip etc.) are loaded automatically with load_dataset() , and it’ll have a dataset viewer on its dataset page on the Hub.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Text extensions greater than 10MB are not tracked by Git LFS by default and will not be committed and uploaded.
claims.quote: Text file extensions are not tracked by Git LFS by default, and if they’re greater than 10MB, they will not be committed and uploaded.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Uploading can be done with huggingface_hub or with Git.
claims.quote: There are two methods for uploading: using huggingface_hub and using Git.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The Zenn page is an AI-generated translation and may contain errors.
claims.quote: The content below is an AI-generated translation. This is an experimental feature, and may contain errors.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: A dataset can be published without developer experience via the Hub UI, but larger or scripted workflows are covered by other routes.
claims.math: The Hub UI page states a web interface for users without developer experience, while the Zenn page lists huggingface_hub and Git as upload methods; combining them gives UI for non-developers and programmatic/Git routes for scripted or large-scale work.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: The live fixtures-index-v4 dataset lists the same files as its manifest and is complete and correct.
claims.missing: The live dataset page, its Files and versions list, its README.md and its manifest would verify this; none of the pages read show that dataset.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: The fixtures-index-v4 dataset declares a license and correct metadata in its dataset card.
claims.missing: The published README.md dataset card metadata would verify this; no page read shows that card.

risks: Text files greater than 10MB may not be committed by default because they are not tracked by Git LFS by default, as shown on the upload page.
Uploading requires authentication with a read and write access token, and organisation permissions if operating under an organisation.
Dataset-card and file-structure choices affect discovery and loading; wrong configs, splits or an incomplete README can make a dataset hard to find or load.
The Zenn article is an AI-generated translation that may contain errors, so it should not be relied on over official documentation.
Private versus public visibility must be chosen at repository creation, limiting who can view a private dataset.
unknowns: The live fixtures-index-v4 dataset lists the same files as its manifest and is complete and correct.: The live dataset page, its Files and versions list, its README.md and its manifest would verify this; none of the pages read show that dataset.
The fixtures-index-v4 dataset declares a license and correct metadata in its dataset card.: The published README.md dataset card metadata would verify this; no page read shows that card.
wouldChangeMind: Finding the live fixtures-index-v4 page listing files that do not match its manifest or whose README is missing.
Finding that the dataset uses an unsupported format or structure that does not load with load_dataset() or show a viewer.
Finding a license, provenance or limitation statement that contradicts responsible reuse.
